articles.abstract_en: Recurrent boom-and-bust cycles are a salient feature of economic and financial history. Cycles found in the data are stochastic, often highly persistent, and span substantial fractions of the sample size. We refer to such cycles as “long”. In this paper, we develop a novel approach to modeling cyclical behavior specifically designed to capture long cycles. We show that existing inferential procedures may produce misleading results in the presence of long cycles and propose a new econometric procedure for the inference on the cycle length. Our procedure is asymptotically valid regardless of the cycle length. We apply our methodology to a set of macroeconomic and financial variables for the U.S. We find evidence of long stochastic cycles in the standard business cycle variables, as well as in credit and house prices. However, we rule out the presence of stochastic cycles in asset market data. Moreover, according to our result, financial cycles, as characterized by credit and house prices, tend to be twice as long as business cycles.
articles.abstract_cn: 反复出现的繁荣与萧条周期是经济与金融史上的一个显著特征。数据中发现的周期是随机的，通常具有高度持续性，并且跨越样本量的相当大比例。我们将此类周期称为“长”周期。在本文中，我们开发了一种新颖的周期行为建模方法，专门设计用于捕捉长周期。我们表明，在存在长周期的情况下，现有的推断程序可能产生误导性结果，并提出了一种新的计量经济学程序，用于对周期长度进行推断。我们的程序在渐近意义上有效，无论周期长度如何。我们将我们的方法应用于美国的一组宏观经济和金融变量。我们在标准商业周期变量以及信贷和房价中发现了长随机周期的证据。然而，我们排除了资产市场数据中存在随机周期的可能性。此外，根据我们的结果，以信贷和房价为特征的金融周期往往比商业周期长两倍。

articles.title_en: Better the devil you know: Improved forecasts from imperfect models
articles.title_cn: 宁要已知的魔鬼：来自不完美模型的改进预测
articles.abstract_en: Many important economic decisions are based on a parametric forecasting model that is known to be good but imperfect. We propose methods to improve out-of-sample forecasts from a misspecified model by estimating its parameters using a form of local M estimation (thereby nesting local OLS and local MLE), drawing on information from a state variable that is correlated with the misspecification of the model. We theoretically consider the forecast environments in which our approach is likely to offer improvements over standard methods, and we find significant forecast improvements from applying the proposed method across four distinct empirical analyses including volatility forecasting, risk management, and yield curve forecasting.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多重要的经济决策基于一个已知良好但不完美的参数预测模型。我们提出方法，通过使用一种局部M估计形式（从而包含局部OLS和局部MLE）来估计其参数，利用与模型误设相关的状态变量信息，从而改进来自误设模型的样本外预测。我们从理论上考虑了我们的方法可能优于标准方法的预测环境，并发现应用所提出的方法在四个不同的实证分析中（包括波动率预测、风险管理和收益率曲线预测）带来了显著的预测改进。

articles.title_en: Nonlinear and nonseparable structural functions in regression discontinuity designs with a continuous treatment
articles.title_cn: 连续处理变量回归不连续设计中的非线性与不可分离结构函数
articles.abstract_en: Many empirical examples of regression discontinuity (RD) designs concern a continuous treatment variable, but the theoretical aspects of such models are less studied. This study examines the identification and estimation of the structural function in fuzzy RD designs with a continuous treatment variable. The structural function fully describes the causal impact of the treatment on the outcome. We show that the nonlinear and nonseparable structural function can be nonparametrically identified at the RD cutoff under shape restrictions, including monotonicity and smoothness conditions. Based on the nonparametric identification equation, we propose a three-step semiparametric estimation procedure and establish the asymptotic normality of the estimator. The semiparametric estimator achieves the same convergence rate as in the case of a binary treatment variable. As an application of the method, we estimate the causal effect of sleep time on health status by using the discontinuity in natural light timing at time zone boundaries.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多回归不连续（RD）设计的实证例子涉及连续处理变量，但此类模型的理论方面研究较少。本研究考察了具有连续处理变量的模糊RD设计中结构函数的识别与估计。结构函数完整描述了处理对结果的因果影响。我们表明，在形状限制（包括单调性和光滑性条件）下，非线性且不可分离的结构函数可以在RD断点处被非参数识别。基于非参数识别方程，我们提出了一个三步半参数估计程序，并建立了估计量的渐近正态性。该半参数估计量达到了与二元处理变量情形相同的收敛速度。作为该方法的一个应用，我们利用时区边界处自然光照时间的间断性，估计了睡眠时间对健康状况的因果效应。

articles.title_cn: 多重处理下的两阶段最小二乘法
articles.abstract_en: We study what two-stage least squares (2SLS) identifies in models with multiple treatments under treatment effect heterogeneity. Two conditions are shown to be necessary and sufficient for the 2SLS to identify positively weighted sums of agent-specific effects of each treatment: average conditional monotonicity and no cross effects. Our identification analysis allows for any number of treatments, any number of continuous or discrete instruments, and the inclusion of covariates. We provide testable implications and present characterizations of choice behavior implied by our identification conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在处理效应异质性下，具有多重处理的两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）所识别的内容。证明了两个条件是2SLS识别每种处理的个体特定效应的正加权和的充分必要条件：平均条件单调性和无交叉效应。我们的识别分析允许任意数量的处理、任意数量的连续或离散工具变量，以及协变量的包含。我们提供了可检验的含义，并给出了由我们的识别条件所隐含的选择行为的特征描述。

articles.title_en: A simple specification test for models with many conditional moment inequalities
articles.title_cn: 具有许多条件矩不等式的模型的简单设定检验
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a simple specification test for partially identified models with a large or possibly uncountably infinite number of conditional moment (in)equalities. The approach is valid under weak assumptions, allowing for both weak identification and non-differentiable moment conditions. Computational simplifications are obtained by reusing certain expensive-to-compute components of the test statistic when constructing the critical values. Because of the weak assumptions, the procedure faces a new set of interesting theoretical issues which we show can be addressed by an unconventional sample-splitting procedure that runs multiple tests of the same null hypothesis. The resulting specification test controls size uniformly over a large class of data generating processes, has power tending to 1 for fixed alternatives, and has power against certain local alternatives which we characterize. Finally, the testing procedure is demonstrated in three simulation exercises.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文针对具有大量或可能不可数无限多个条件矩（不）等式的部分识别模型，提出了一种简单的设定检验。该方法在弱假设下有效，允许弱识别和非可微矩条件。通过在建临界值时重用检验统计量中某些计算成本高昂的组成部分，获得了计算简化。由于弱假设，该过程面临一系列新的有趣理论问题，我们表明可以通过一种非常规的样本分割程序来解决这些问题，该程序对相同的原假设进行多次检验。由此产生的设定检验在广泛的数据生成过程类别上均匀控制大小，对固定备择假设的功效趋于1，并且对某些我们表征的局部备择假设具有功效。最后，该检验程序在三个模拟练习中得到了演示。

articles.title_en: Maximum likelihood estimation of a spatial autoregressive model for origin–destination flow variables
articles.title_cn: 起点-终点流量变量空间自回归模型的最大似然估计
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a spatial autoregressive hurdle model for nonnegative origin–destination flows yN,ij. The model incorporates a hurdle formulation to elucidate the different data-generating processes for zero and positive flows. Our model specifies three types of spatial influences on flow yN,ij that quantify the impact of third-party characteristics on the flow yN,ij: (i) the effect of outflows from origin j, (ii) the effect of inflows to destination i, and (iii) the effect of flows among third-party units. We account for two-way fixed effects in the model to capture the inherent characteristics of both origins and destinations. We employ maximum likelihood estimation to estimate the model parameters. To address statistical inference issues, we analyze the asymptotic properties of the ML estimator using the spatial near-epoch dependence concept. We confirm the presence of an asymptotic bias that arises from the fixed effects, whose dimensions grow with the sample size. Applying our model to migration flows among U.S. states, we estimate significant spatial influences, particularly from inflows to destinations and outflows from origins. Our findings support the notion that zero and positive flow formations are distinct. Consequently, our proposed model outperforms the spatial autoregressive Tobit specification for origin–destination flows, thus providing a better fit to the data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个针对非负起点-终点流量yN,ij的空间自回归障碍模型。该模型采用障碍公式来阐明零流量和正流量的不同数据生成过程。我们的模型指定了三种对流量yN,ij的空间影响类型，用以量化第三方特征对流量yN,ij的影响：(i) 来自起点j的流出效应，(ii) 流向目的地i的流入效应，以及(iii) 第三方单位之间的流动效应。我们在模型中考虑了双向固定效应，以捕捉起点和目的地的固有特征。我们采用最大似然估计来估计模型参数。为了解决统计推断问题，我们使用空间近邻依赖概念分析了ML估计量的渐近性质。我们确认了由固定效应引起的渐近偏差的存在，其维度随样本量增长。将我们的模型应用于美国各州之间的迁移流量，我们估计出显著的空间影响，特别是来自目的地的流入和起点的流出。我们的发现支持零流量和正流量形成是不同的这一观点。因此，我们提出的模型优于起点-终点流量的空间自回归Tobit规范，从而更好地拟合了数据。

articles.title_en: On the performance of the Neyman Allocation with small pilots
articles.title_cn: 关于小规模预试验下Neyman分配的绩效研究
articles.abstract_en: The Neyman Allocation is used in many papers on experimental design, which typically assume that researchers have access to large pilot studies. This may be unrealistic. To understand the properties of the Neyman Allocation with small pilots, we study its behavior in an asymptotic framework that takes pilot size to be fixed even as the size of the main wave tends to infinity. Our analysis shows that the Neyman Allocation can lead to estimates of the ATE with higher asymptotic variance than with (non-adaptive) balanced randomization. In particular, this happens when the outcome variable is relatively homoskedastic with respect to treatment status or when it exhibits high kurtosis. We provide a series of empirical examples showing that such situations can arise in practice. Our results suggest that researchers with small pilots should not use the Neyman Allocation if they believe that outcomes are homoskedastic or heavy-tailed. Finally, we examine some potential methods for improving the finite sample performance of the FNA via simulations.
articles.abstract_cn: Neyman分配在众多实验设计论文中被使用，这些论文通常假设研究者能够获得大规模的预试验。这可能并不现实。为了理解小规模预试验下Neyman分配的性质，我们在一个渐近框架下研究其行为，该框架将预试验规模视为固定，即使主波次规模趋于无穷大。我们的分析表明，Neyman分配可能导致ATE估计的渐近方差高于（非自适应的）平衡随机化。特别是，当结果变量相对于处理状态相对同方差或表现出高峰度时，这种情况会发生。我们提供了一系列实证例子，表明这种情况在实践中可能出现。我们的结果表明，如果研究者认为结果是同方差或重尾的，那么拥有小规模预试验的研究者不应使用Neyman分配。最后，我们通过模拟检验了一些可能改善FNA有限样本性能的方法。

articles.title_en: Prewhitened long-run variance estimation robust to nonstationarity
articles.title_cn: 预白化长期方差估计对非平稳性的稳健性
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a nonparametric nonlinear VAR prewhitened long-run variance (LRV) estimator for the construction of standard errors robust to autocorrelation and heteroskedasticity that can be used for hypothesis testing in a variety of contexts including the linear regression model. Existing methods either are theoretically valid only under stationarity and have poor finite-sample properties under nonstationarity (i.e., fixed-b methods), or are theoretically valid under the null hypothesis but lead to tests that are not consistent under nonstationary alternative hypothesis (i.e., both fixed-b and traditional HAC estimators). The proposed estimator accounts explicitly for nonstationarity, unlike previous prewhitened procedures which are known to be unreliable, and leads to tests with accurate null rejection rates and good monotonic power. We also establish MSE bounds for LRV estimation that are sharper than previously established and use them to determine the data-dependent bandwidths.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种非参数非线性VAR预白化长期方差（LRV）估计量，用于构建对自相关和异方差稳健的标准误，可在包括线性回归模型在内的多种情境下用于假设检验。现有方法要么仅在平稳性下理论上有效，且在非平稳性下有限样本性质较差（即固定b方法），要么在零假设下理论上有效，但在非平稳备择假设下导致检验不一致（即固定b和传统HAC估计量）。所提出的估计量明确考虑了非平稳性，不同于已知不可靠的先前预白化程序，并导致具有准确零假设拒绝率和良好单调功效的检验。我们还建立了比先前更尖锐的LRV估计的均方误差界，并利用它们确定数据依赖的带宽。
